messages:
samir: FYI Acme support ticket — intermittent 401s hitting /v1/generate. Started ~10:10 UTC. Logs show invalid_signature / kid not found.

samir: example log: `ERROR verify_token: invalid_signature, kid=abc123, token_id=tx-983`

maria: looking... grabbing trace for request id tx-983, sending to idp-infra for correlation.

kevin: quick question — did anything change on our side (deploys/keys) around that time?

maria: no deploys to verifier service. However, requests show tokens with two different iss values: `https://idp.acme.com/` and `https://sso.external-idp.com/`. Both issuers happen to have a key with kid `abc123`.

kevin: oh that sounds like a cache collision. How does our verifier key cache index JWKS?

maria: looks like current cache key is derived from parsed host + kid (we collapse issuer URL to hostname). If two different issuers share a kid we can return the wrong JWKS.

maria: repro steps I used locally:
```
# token header
{ "alg": "RS256", "kid": "abc123", "iss": "https://idp.acme.com/", "aud": "redwood-api" }
# curl to our stub verifier
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -v
# verifier log shows fetching jwks from https://sso.external-idp.com/.well-known/jwks.json (wrong issuer)
```

idp-infra: confirming — external idp rotates frequently and their kid namespace is not global. They confirmed same kid id exists.

kevin: ooof. That explains intermittent nature (depends on cache state & route). Workaround ideas?

maria: immediate mitigation: 1) purge verifier JWKS caches across fleet, 2) lower JWKS TTL to 30s while we patch, 3) add more logging to measure issuer->jwks_url mapping.

oncall-bot: runbook trigger acknowledged. Suggested action: `runbook/jwks-cache-purge` — can run as admin.

support-bot: pinged Acme with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix.

ops_lead: do the purge + TTL change now. Then deploy a fix that uses full issuer URL + aud in the cache key (normalize trailing slash). Put canary at 5%.

maria: small patch (pseudo):
```
// old cache key
cacheKey = hostFrom(issuer) + '|' + kid;
// new cache key
cacheKey = normalizeIssuer(issuer) + '|' + aud + '|' + kid;
function normalizeIssuer(u) { return u.replace(/\/+$/,'').toLowerCase(); }
```
This prevents cross-issuer kid collisions and handles trailing slash inconsistencies.

kevin: also add an explicit mapping check: after fetching JWKS, verify that at least one key in the set has the requested kid and that the jwks.issuer (if provided) matches expected iss. If mismatch, refetch from issuer's well-known.

maria: will add tests (two issuers same kid) and unit for normalization.

oncall-bot: executing `./scripts/purge-jwks-cache --all` now (rolling). Output: "purge queued -> 4000 nodes".

idp-infra: we deployed temporary TTL change to 30s and verified purge completed on 98% of nodes. A handful will drain, monitoring catching them.

ops_lead: start canary of verifier v2.1.4 (with new cacheKey) to 5% traffic. Watch signature_fail metric.

maria: canary looks good after 10m: signature_failures for canary group = 0, control = 12/min.

kevin: good. ramp to 50% then 100% slowly, keep TTL change for 1h and revert to normal TTL once stable.

support-bot: Acme notified of fix and asked to confirm they see no more 401s.

maria: rolled to 100% at +55m. Post-deploy checks: signature failures down to baseline, no perf regressions. Added a dashboard chart for issuer->kid collisions and a pager if >5 per minute.

samir: thanks all. Action items:
- maria: PR for unit tests & patch merged (done).
- kevin: add integration test in e2e runner for multi-issuer same-kid scenario.
- ops_lead: follow up on TTL revert and postmortem note for customers.

samir: closing loop with Acme; they confirmed error stopped after ~20m. :white_check_mark:

maria: will open a short RFC to formalize cache key rules and add library helpers.

kevin: nice catch. Lesson: never key JWKS cache by host alone.

support-bot: incident resolved, severity P2 -> downgraded.

ops_lead: filing postmortem and recommending we ship safer defaults in the verification lib (normalize issuer, include aud, shorter default TTL).

maria: logging note — added `verifier.issuer_mismatch` metric so we can alert earlier.

samir: great work everyone. :thumbsup:
